claims.text: This is a service repository with 4 routes, consumers, or scheduled jobs.
It is built primarily with Python (43 source files, 8,201 lines), along with JavaScript (3 files, 852 lines), CSS (1 file, 234 lines), and HTML (2 files, 38 lines).
The project uses GitHub Actions for CI/CD with workflows for CI, evaluation, and pages deployment.
The Python project configuration is managed via core/pyproject.toml.
SQLite is used as a database, cache, or queue.
The GITHUB_TOKEN setting is read from the environment in core/src/plumb/cli.py.
A POST request to /api/jobs is handled by the add_job function in core/src/plumb/server/app.py, which calls parse_github in core/src/plumb/source.py and _view.
A GET request to /api/jobs/{job_id} is handled by the get_job function in core/src/plumb/server/app.py, which calls _view.
The service exposes four HTTP routes under the /api prefix, all defined in core/src/plumb/server/app.py using FastAPI.
The routes are GET /api/health, POST /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{job_id}, and GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/facts.
A CLI package entry point named plumb is declared in core/pyproject.toml pointing to plumb.cli:app.
Eight Typer commands are implemented in core/src/plumb/cli.py: schema, analyse, report, serve, worker, build, and index.
Three standalone script entry points exist in the eval directory: judge.py, provider_cors.py, and run.py.
core/src/plumb and core/src/plumb/server each use the other.

Run linting and formatting checks with uv run ruff check . ../eval and uv run ruff format --check . ../eval.

Run the evaluation suite with uv run python ../eval/run.py.
